name: app-black-insight-cards-with-gradient-blobs
title: Insight Cards with Gradient Blobs
whatItIs: A black slide with three rounded cards in a row: a blue-gradient card partly cut off, a white card 'The distribution of tasks is inequitable' with a pale donut, and an orange-yellow gradient card, captioned 'A collection of insights gathered from user interviews'.
whatItMeans: Colour-coded cards with soft gradient blobs make interview findings feel distinct and memorable. The cropped edges suggest a carousel.
techniques: Cropped side cards implying horizontal scroll
One blue highlighted phrase in each headline
Soft gradient blob rising from the card base
Donut chart as a simple statistic visual

vocabulary.definition: A card summarising one research finding.
Cards cut off at the sides to imply scrolling.
A soft colour cloud used as background.
